object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a clean 64-bit Windows 11 virtual machine with no Mellon installed, sign in as a standard user without administrator rights and run the Windows installer with the default answers. Expected: no administrator prompt appears; no page offers a choice of install folder; the installation ends without error; Mellon is installed in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mellon and nowhere under Program Files.
